review.summary: Completed narrow, source-only runtime call-graph inspection of IrSource::load(JSON) and associated Serde/binary serialization, equality, and transient_crypto::curve::Fr operations within the public packet (preserving the prior 420s-exhausted 386-file inspection as unavailable). Within the inspected public packet sources (sdk-public-code/zkir-v3/src/{ir.rs,ir_types.rs,lib.rs}, sdk-public-code/transient-crypto/src/{curve.rs,macros.rs}, sdk-public-code/base-crypto/src/fab/{mod.rs,alignments.rs,encoding.rs,serialize.rs}, and sdk-public-code/serialize{,-macros}/src/*), IrSource::load(&[u8]), Serde serialization/deserialization, binary Serializable/Deserializable, and PartialEq perform only in-memory reader/writer operations, heap allocations (serde_json::Value, String, Vec, Arc), version/tag validation, hex encoding/decoding, and BLS12-381 scalar field (Fr / midnight_curves::Fq) canonical byte conversion, negation, and equality. They do not invoke Zkir trait methods, IrSource::model, midnight_zk_stdlib, midnight_proofs, midnight_circuits, SRS/key providers, or the IR VM, nor do they invoke <Fr as serde::Serialize/Deserialize> or <Fr as Serializable/Deserializable> (since Operand serializes Fr immediates as '0x...' hex strings via Fr::as_le_bytes / Fr::from_le_bytes). Full no-I/O and safety closure is not claimed because external registry leaf implementations (midnight-curves, ff, serde/serde_json/serde_repr, const-hex) and build-time proc-macro/build.rs closure are outside this public packet and remain separate/open.
findings: [READ/STATIC] Prior broad 386-file compiler SDK inspection exhausted 420s with zero valid result; it is preserved as unavailable and zero findings are inherited from it.

[READ/STATIC] Entry point IrSource::load<R: Read>(reader: R) -> io::Result<Self> (sdk-public-code/zkir-v3/src/ir.rs:955-989): (1) calls serde_json::from_reader(reader)? (ir.rs:956) to parse the input stream into serde_json::Value; (2) requires serde_json::Value::Object(mut obj) or returns Err(InvalidData, 'Expected a JSON object') (ir.rs:958, 984-987); (3) extracts and clones obj.get('version') or returns Err(InvalidData, 'Expected a version entry') (ir.rs:960-965), deserializing it via serde_json::from_value::<SerdeVersion> where SerdeVersion { major: u8, minor: u8 } derives serde::Deserialize (ir.rs:922-926, 959-966); (4) enforces SerdeVersion { major: 3, minor: 0..=0 } or returns Err(InvalidData, format!('Unhandled version: {major}.{minor}')) (ir.rs:968-981); (5) replaces 'version' in obj with serde_json::Value::Number(ver.minor.into()) (ir.rs:972-975) and deserializes IrSource via serde_json::from_value(serde_json::Value::Object(obj))? (ir.rs:976). When R is &[u8], Read::read is pure in-memory slice reading with no OS I/O.

[READ/STATIC] IrSource structure and derived Serde/equality paths (sdk-public-code/zkir-v3/src/ir.rs:35-50): IrSource derives Default, Clone, Debug, PartialEq, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize, and serialize::Serializable. Its fields deserialize/serialize/compare as follows: (a) version: IrMinorVersion (ir.rs:39, 54-70) is a #[repr(u8)] enum with single variant V0 = 0 using serde_repr::Serialize_repr and serde_repr::Deserialize_repr; (b) inputs: Vec<TypedIdentifier> (ir.rs:41, 168-174) derives Serialize/Deserialize/PartialEq over name: Identifier(String) (ir.rs:160-162, which deserializes any JSON string without a '%' prefix check) and #[serde(rename = 'type')] val_t: IrType (ir.rs:172-173); (c) outputs: Vec<IrType> (ir.rs:45); (d) do_communications_commitment: bool (ir.rs:47); (e) instructions: Arc<Vec<Instruction>> (ir.rs:49), deserialized via serde's 'rc' feature enabled in sdk-public-code/zkir-v3/Cargo.toml:48.

[READ/STATIC] IrType runtime behavior vs uninvoked IrValue/CircuitValue definitions (sdk-public-code/zkir-v3/src/ir_types.rs:34-89 vs 91-349): IrType is a 13-variant fieldless enum deriving Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Serializable with explicit #[serde(rename = ...)] string tags ('Scalar<BLS12-381>', 'Bytes<32>', 'Point<Jubjub>', 'Scalar<Jubjub>', 'Point<Secp256k1>', 'Base<Secp256k1>', 'Scalar<Secp256k1>', 'Point<Secp256r1>', 'Base<Secp256r1>', 'Scalar<Secp256r1>', 'Point<Curve25519>', 'Base<Curve25519>', 'Scalar<Curve25519>'). Deserializing, serializing, or comparing IrType performs pure enum variant tag matching. IrType::encoded_len (ir_types.rs:93-114), IrValue (ir_types.rs:119-204), CircuitValue (ir_types.rs:211-274), and impl_enum_from_try_from! (ir_types.rs:278-349) are definitions only and are never invoked during IrSource::load, Serde, Serializable, or PartialEq.

[READ/STATIC] Instruction enum Serde and Alignment nested types (sdk-public-code/zkir-v3/src/ir.rs:357-919; sdk-public-code/base-crypto/src/fab/encoding.rs:182-184, 265-278, 637-650): Instruction derives Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, Serializable with #[serde(rename_all = 'snake_case', tag = 'op')]. Its 30 variants contain only Operand, Identifier, Vec<Identifier>, (Identifier, Identifier), Vec<Operand>, (Operand, Operand), Option<Operand>, u32, IrType, and (in PersistentHash at ir.rs:709-716 and Keccak256 at ir.rs:721-728) base_crypto::fab::Alignment. Alignment derives Serialize/Deserialize/PartialEq as #[serde(transparent)] Vec<AlignmentSegment> (encoding.rs:182-184), where AlignmentSegment (encoding.rs:265-278) is #[serde(tag = 'tag', content = 'value', rename_all = 'camelCase')] enum { Atom(AlignmentAtom), Option(Vec<Alignment>) } and AlignmentAtom (encoding.rs:637-650) is #[serde(tag = 'tag', rename_all = 'camelCase')] enum { Compress, Bytes { length: u32 }, Field }. No hashing, circuit synthesis, or VM execution occurs when deserializing, serializing, or comparing Instruction or Alignment.

[READ/STATIC] Custom Operand Serde and reachable transient_crypto::curve::Fr methods (sdk-public-code/zkir-v3/src/ir.rs:188-246; sdk-public-code/transient-crypto/src/curve.rs:50-56, 156-161, 192-194, 346-354, 370-372; sdk-public-code/transient-crypto/src/macros.rs:40-46): (1) <Operand as serde::Deserialize>::deserialize (ir.rs:203-246) deserializes a String (ir.rs:208), strips an optional leading '-' setting negate: bool (ir.rs:211-217), and branches on '0x'/'0X' prefix (ir.rs:219): (a) for hex immediates, rejects empty hex digits (ir.rs:221-225), decodes bytes via const_hex::decode(hex_str) (ir.rs:227-230), calls Fr::from_le_bytes(&bytes) (ir.rs:231-233), and if negate is true applies unary negation -field via <Fr as std::ops::Neg>::neg (ir.rs:234 -> macros.rs:40-46), returning Ok(Operand::Immediate(...)); (b) otherwise requires s.starts_with('%') or returns a custom Serde error, wrapping valid strings in Ok(Operand::Variable(Identifier(s))) (ir.rs:237-243). (2) Fr::from_le_bytes (curve.rs:346-354) allocates stack array [0u8; FR_BYTES] (32 bytes), rejects slices longer than FR_BYTES with None, copies bytes into the prefix, and calls outer::Scalar::from_repr(repr).map(Fr).into() where outer::Scalar is midnight_curves::Fq (curve.rs:55). (3) <Operand as serde::Serialize>::serialize (ir.rs:188-201) serializes Variable(id) as &id.0, and Immediate(imm) by calling imm.as_le_bytes() (ir.rs:193 -> curve.rs:370-372, which calls self.0.to_bytes_le().to_vec()), popping trailing 0u8 bytes while repr.len() > 1 (ir.rs:194-196), and formatting '0x' + const_hex::encode(&repr) (ir.rs:197).

[READ/STATIC] Explicit distinction between invoked methods and uninvoked trait definitions on Fr and IrSource: (1) field_serialize!(Fr, outer::Scalar, to_bytes_le) (curve.rs:87-153, 161) defines <Fr as serde::Serialize> and <Fr as serde::Deserialize> (using serde_bytes::ByteBuf and ScaleBigInt), <Fr as Serializable>, and <Fr as Deserializable>, but NONE of these are invoked by IrSource JSON Serde OR IrSource binary Serializable/Deserializable because Operand implements both serde::Serialize/Deserialize (ir.rs:188-246) and serialize::Serializable/Deserializable (ir.rs:248-342) directly over hex strings via Fr::as_le_bytes and Fr::from_le_bytes. (2) In wrap_field_arith!(Fr) (macros.rs:14-56), only Neg::neg (macros.rs:40-46) is reachable during IrSource::load (and only on '-0x...' immediates); Add, Sub, Mul, and Div (with .invert().unwrap()) are uninvoked definitions. (3) #[derive(Storable)] on Fr (curve.rs:156), fr_display! (macros.rs:94-119), Hash (curve.rs:179-183), Distribution/Standard (curve.rs:185-189), Dummy (curve.rs:198-202), Aligned (curve.rs:291-295), integer From/TryFrom impls (curve.rs:240-289, 591-651), Fr::from_uniform_bytes (curve.rs:359-361), EmbeddedFr, and EmbeddedGroupAffine are uninvoked definitions during IrSource::load, serialization, and equality. (4) If binary Serializable/Deserializable is called on IrSource, it executes the proc-macro expansion in sdk-public-code/serialize-macros/src/lib.rs:50-147 and primitives in sdk-public-code/serialize/src/{serializable.rs,deserializable.rs,util.rs} plus Alignment's flagged-int encoding in sdk-public-code/base-crypto/src/fab/serialize.rs:167-277 and Operand's manual impl in ir.rs:248-342 (pure in-memory Read/Write when used on byte slices/Vec<u8>, with 32 MiB per-Vec preallocation cap in Vec::with_bounded_capacity at serialize/src/util.rs:36-42 and recursion depth limit 50 debug / 250 release at serialize/src/deserializable.rs:23-26, 142-153). (5) None of <IrSource as Zkir>::{check, prove, k, keygen_vk, keygen, load_ir_from_tagged, load_prover_key_from_tagged, read_raw_pk, write_raw_pk} (ir.rs:72-156), IrSource::model (ir.rs:948-952), or IrSource::prove_unchecked (ir.rs:993-1012) are reachable from IrSource::load, Serde, Serializable, or PartialEq; thus zero calls to midnight_zk_stdlib, midnight_proofs, midnight_circuits, SRS/ParamsProverProvider, keygen, or the IR VM occur. (6) File-I/O helpers tag_enforcement_test! (serialize/src/util.rs:579-606, gated by #[cfg(test)]) and gen_static_serialize_file / test_file_deserialize (serialize/src/util.rs:527-539) are never called by IrSource::load or runtime serialization.

[UNVERIFIED] Exact unresolved external leaf calls outside the public packet reached at runtime by IrSource::load(&[u8]), Serde serialization, and PartialEq: (1) serde_json (^1.0.0) and serde (^1.0.0 with derive, rc): serde_json::from_reader, serde_json::from_value, serde_json::to_string/to_vec, Value::Object/Number, Arc Serialize/Deserialize, and #[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)] expansions; (2) serde_repr (^0.1.0): #[derive(Serialize_repr, Deserialize_repr)] on IrMinorVersion; (3) const-hex (^1.14.0): const_hex::decode and const_hex::encode; (4) midnight-curves (^0.3.1) and ff (^0.13.1): <midnight_curves::Fq as ff::PrimeField>::NUM_BITS, <midnight_curves::Fq as ff::PrimeField>::from_repr and CtOption::into, midnight_curves::Fq::to_bytes_le, <midnight_curves::Fq as std::ops::Neg>::neg, <midnight_curves::Fq as PartialEq>::eq, and <midnight_curves::Fq as Default>::default.
